title: Web3 Reputation Clustering
tagline: Lens protocol recommendation system help users discover similar users or content
description:
Lens protocol needs a recommendation system to help users discover similar users or similar content
Figured out project road map.
used lens api to pull all data from lens
used ArangoDb graph data base to discover lens recommendation
used react to provide the front end
Used ML clustering and Jupiter notebook to detect community.
Used 3d graph to generate similar connections
how_its_made:
- used lens api to pull all data from lens
- used ArangoDb graph data base to discover lens recommendation
- Used subgraph to pull posts repost information.
- used react to provide the front end
Used ML clustering and Jupiter notebook to detect community.
Used 3d graph to generate similar connections
